decision.explanation: The question asks for the birth date of Admiral King-Hall. Multiple documents (D1S2, D2S5, D3S1) directly state that George Fowler King-Hall was born on 14 August 1850. Other dates (e.g., 14 August 1900, 15 March 1862, 11 March 1816) refer to different individuals within the same family (e.g., another Admiral King-Hall or his father/brother). These are not relevant to the specific question about Admiral George Fowler King-Hall. Conflicts between these dates arise because they refer to different people, not contradictory claims about the same individual.
